inputs.description: Pacote do Core para rodar testes unitários isolados

tasks.label: TS: Compilar tudo
tasks.command: pnpm -C packages/core build && pnpm -C apps/api build && pnpm -C apps/web build

tasks.label: TS: So validar tipos
tasks.command: pnpm -C packages/core typecheck && pnpm -C apps/api typecheck && pnpm -C apps/web typecheck

tasks.label: Backend: Desligar
tasks.command: bash -lc 'set +e; pids="$(lsof -tiTCP:3333 -sTCP:LISTEN 2>/dev/null)"; if [ -n "$pids" ]; then kill -TERM $pids 2>/dev/null; sleep 1; kill -KILL $pids 2>/dev/null; fi; pkill -TERM -f "apps/api/src/server.ts|pnpm -C apps/api exec|node --env-file=.env --import tsx|tsx src/server.ts|apps/api/dist/.+server" 2>/dev/null; sleep 1; pkill -KILL -f "apps/api/src/server.ts|pnpm -C apps/api exec|node --env-file=.env --import tsx|tsx src/server.ts|apps/api/dist/.+server" 2>/dev/null; true'

tasks.label: Frontend: Desligar
tasks.command: bash -lc "pids=$(lsof -tiTCP:5173 -sTCP:LISTEN 2>/dev/null); if [ -n \"$pids\" ]; then kill $pids; else pkill -f 'vite.*--host 0.0.0.0|pnpm -C apps/web dev' || true; fi"

tasks.label: Prisma: Gerar schema e client API
tasks.command: npx prisma db pull --schema=apps/api/prisma/schema.prisma && npx prisma generate --schema=apps/api/prisma/schema.prisma

tasks.label: API: Reset runtime local
tasks.command: bash -lc "set -euo pipefail; cd '${workspaceFolder}'; echo '==> Encerrando processos locais da API'; pkill -f 'apps/api/src/server.ts' 2>/dev/null || true; pkill -f 'tsx src/index.ts' 2>/dev/null || true; pkill -f 'node --env-file=.env --import tsx src/server.ts' 2>/dev/null || true; echo '==> Limpando dist locais'; rm -rf apps/api/dist packages/core/dist apps/web/dist; echo '==> Removendo cópias empacotadas de @core-kit/api'; rm -rf node_modules/@core-kit/api 2>/dev/null || true; rm -rf node_modules/.pnpm/node_modules/@core-kit/api 2>/dev/null || true; echo '==> Instalando dependências'; pnpm install; echo '==> Gerando Prisma Client'; pnpm -C apps/api exec prisma generate --schema=prisma/schema.prisma; echo '==> Buildando core'; pnpm -C packages/core build; echo '==> Buildando api'; pnpm -C apps/api build; echo '==> Subindo API via source'; cd apps/api && node --env-file=.env --import tsx src/server.ts"

tasks.label: concat:core:src
tasks.command:
mkdir -p tmp/concat && : > tmp/concat/core-src.txt && find packages/core/src -type f \( -name "*.ts" -o -name "*.tsx" -o -name "*.js" -o -name "*.json" -o -name "*.md" \) -print0 | sort -z | while IFS= read -r -d '' file; do printf '

===== %s =====

' "$file" >> tmp/concat/core-src.txt; cat "$file" >> tmp/concat/core-src.txt; done

tasks.label: concat:core:tests
tasks.command:
mkdir -p tmp/concat && : > tmp/concat/core-tests.txt && if [ -d packages/core/__tests__ ]; then find packages/core/__tests__ -type f \( -name "*.ts" -o -name "*.tsx" -o -name "*.js" -o -name "*.json" -o -name "*.md" \) -print0 | sort -z | while IFS= read -r -d '' file; do printf '

===== %s =====

' "$file" >> tmp/concat/core-tests.txt; cat "$file" >> tmp/concat/core-tests.txt; done; fi

tasks.label: analise:mapa-arquitetural
tasks.command: mkdir -p tmp/analise && { echo '# Mapa Arquitetural Automático'; echo; echo '## packages/core/src'; find packages/core/src -type d | sort; echo; echo '## apps/api/src'; find apps/api/src -type d | sort; echo; echo '## apps/web'; find apps/web -type d | sort; } > tmp/analise/mapa-arquitetural.md

tasks.label: analise:imports-core
tasks.command: mkdir -p tmp/analise && grep -RInE "^import .* from ['\"]|^export .* from ['\"]" packages/core/src --include='*.ts' --include='*.tsx' > tmp/analise/imports-core.txt || true

tasks.label: analise:violacoes-core
tasks.command: mkdir -p tmp/analise && { echo '# Possíveis violações arquiteturais no Core'; echo; echo '## Imports proibidos no Core'; grep -RInE "from ['\"].*(prisma|fastify|express|http|axios|react|@prisma|node:fs|fs|node:path|path)['\"]" packages/core/src --include='*.ts' --include='*.tsx' || true; echo; echo '## usuarios importando tokens/rbac/auth'; grep -RInE "from ['\"].*(tokens|rbac|auth)" packages/core/src/usuarios --include='*.ts' --include='*.tsx' || true; echo; echo '## tokens importando rbac/auth'; grep -RInE "from ['\"].*(rbac|auth)" packages/core/src/tokens --include='*.ts' --include='*.tsx' || true; echo; echo '## rbac importando tokens/auth'; grep -RInE "from ['\"].*(tokens|auth)" packages/core/src/rbac --include='*.ts' --include='*.tsx' || true; echo; echo '## pacotes base importando auth'; grep -RInE "from ['\"].*auth" packages/core/src/locatarios packages/core/src/usuarios packages/core/src/tokens packages/core/src/rbac --include='*.ts' --include='*.tsx' || true; } > tmp/analise/violacoes-core.md

tasks.label: analise:result-vs-throw
tasks.command: mkdir -p tmp/analise && { echo '# Análise Result vs Throw'; echo; echo '## Ocorrências de throw no Core'; grep -RIn "throw " packages/core/src --include='*.ts' --include='*.tsx' || true; echo; echo '## Uso de Result / Ok / Err'; grep -RInE "Result<|wrapOk|wrapErr|ok\(|err\(|createErroApp|ErroApp" packages/core/src --include='*.ts' --include='*.tsx' || true; echo; echo '## Possíveis try/catch no Core'; grep -RInE "try \{|catch \(" packages/core/src --include='*.ts' --include='*.tsx' || true; } > tmp/analise/result-vs-throw.md

tasks.label: analise:api-auth-contexto
tasks.command: mkdir -p tmp/analise && { echo '# Análise API Auth / Contexto'; echo; echo '## Possíveis pontos de composição de auth'; grep -RInE "runtime|authRuntime|criar.*Auth|emitirSessao|validarSessao|rotacionarRefresh|resolverContexto" apps/api/src --include='*.ts' --include='*.tsx' || true; echo; echo '## Possíveis aberturas de contexto SQL/RLS'; grep -RInE "executarComContexto|executarAuthComContexto|set_config|locatario_id|RLS|contexto SQL" apps/api/src packages/core/src --include='*.ts' --include='*.tsx' || true; echo; echo '## Possíveis usos de as any'; grep -RIn "as any" apps/api/src packages/core/src --include='*.ts' --include='*.tsx' || true; } > tmp/analise/api-auth-contexto.md

tasks.label: analise:composicao-proibida
tasks.command: mkdir -p tmp/analise && { echo '# Composição proibida'; echo; grep -RInE 'createAuthHttpRuntime\(|createAutorizacaoHttpRuntime\(' apps/api/src --include='*.ts' --include='*.tsx' | grep -v 'bootstrap/' | grep -v 'infra/prisma/auth/' | grep -v 'infra/prisma/autorizacao/' || true; } > tmp/analise/composicao-proibida.md

tasks.label: analise:throw-core
tasks.command: mkdir -p tmp/analise && { echo '# Throws proibidos no Core'; echo; grep -RIn 'throw new Error' packages/core/src --include='*.ts' --include='*.tsx' || true; } > tmp/analise/throw-core.md

tasks.label: analise:imports-cruzados
tasks.command: mkdir -p tmp/analise && { echo '# Imports cruzados'; echo; grep -RInE 'from .*modules/' apps/api/src/modules --include='*.ts' --include='*.tsx' || true; } > tmp/analise/imports-cruzados.md

tasks.label: analise:dependencias-modulos
tasks.command: mkdir -p tmp/analise && for dir in apps/api/src/modules/*; do module=$(basename "$dir"); echo "## $module" >> tmp/analise/dependencias-modulos.md; grep -RhoE "from ['\"][^'\"]+" "$dir" --include='*.ts' | sort | uniq >> tmp/analise/dependencias-modulos.md || true; echo >> tmp/analise/dependencias-modulos.md; done

tasks.label: analise:rls-ilegal
tasks.command: mkdir -p tmp/analise && { echo '# Possíveis aberturas ilegais de contexto'; echo; grep -RIn 'executarComContexto' apps/api/src --include='*.ts' | grep -v 'authPrismaContexto' | grep -v 'execucaoComContexto' || true; } > tmp/analise/rls-ilegal.md

tasks.label: analise:metricas
tasks.command: mkdir -p tmp/analise && { echo '# Métricas'; echo; echo '## Controllers'; find apps/api/src -iname '*controller.ts' | wc -l; echo; echo '## Repositórios'; find apps/api/src -iname '*Repositorio*.ts' | wc -l; echo; echo '## Throws'; grep -RIn 'throw ' packages/core/src apps/api/src --include='*.ts' | wc -l; echo; echo '## TODO/FIXME'; grep -RInE 'TODO|FIXME' apps/api/src packages/core/src --include='*.ts' || true; echo; echo '## as any'; grep -RIn 'as any' apps/api/src packages/core/src --include='*.ts' || true; } > tmp/analise/metricas.md

tasks.label: seguranca:auth-sem-vazamento
tasks.command: mkdir -p tmp/analise && { echo '# Vazamento de permissões/módulos em Auth'; echo; grep -RInE 'permissoes|modulosHabilitados|modulos|papeis' apps/api/src/modules/auth apps/api/src/middlewares/authGuard.ts apps/api/src/infra/prisma/auth/jwtPorta.ts --include='*.ts' || true; } > tmp/analise/auth-sem-vazamento.md

tasks.label: analise:contratos-auth-core
tasks.command: mkdir -p tmp/analise && { echo '# Contratos Auth Core'; echo; grep -RInE 'export interface .*Auth|export type .*Auth|emitirAccessToken|gerarHash|comparar|criarRefresh|validarRefresh' packages/core/src/auth packages/core/src/kernel --include='*.ts' || true; } > tmp/analise/contratos-auth-core.md

tasks.command:
if grep -R "apps/web/src" -n apps/web/src; then echo '
ERRO: imports absolutos apps/web/src detectados'; exit 1; else echo 'OK: imports web válidos'; fi

===== %s =====

' "$file" >> tmp/concat/postgresql-docs.txt; cat "$file" >> tmp/concat/postgresql-docs.txt; done

tasks.label: Prisma · Inspecionar Modelo
args: echo '=== MODELS ===' && grep '^model ' apps/api/prisma/schema.prisma && echo '' && echo '=== ENUMS ===' && grep '^enum ' apps/api/prisma/schema.prisma && echo '' && echo '=== PKS COMPOSTAS ===' && grep -n '@@id' apps/api/prisma/schema.prisma && echo '' && echo '=== UNIQUES ===' && grep -n '@@unique' apps/api/prisma/schema.prisma && echo '' && echo '=== REFERÊNCIAS ANTIGAS ===' && grep -RInE 'db\.(tokens|modulos_assinatura|movimentos_estoque)|cliente_id_locatario_id|fornecedor_id_locatario_id|produto_id_locatario_id|transacao_id_locatario_id|locatario_id_item_transacao_id_transacao_id|locatario_id: null' apps/api/src || true && echo '' && echo '=== TYPESCRIPT ===' && pnpm -C apps/api exec tsc --noEmit

tasks.label: Prisma · Pull + Generate + Check

tasks.label: Prisma · Diagnóstico
tasks.command: echo '=== MODELS ==='; grep '^model ' apps/api/prisma/schema.prisma; echo ''; echo '=== PKS ==='; grep '@@id' apps/api/prisma/schema.prisma; echo ''; echo '=== REFERÊNCIAS ANTIGAS ==='; grep -RInE 'modulos_assinatura|movimentos_estoque|cliente_id_locatario_id|fornecedor_id_locatario_id|produto_id_locatario_id|transacao_id_locatario_id|locatario_id_item_transacao_id_transacao_id|locatario_id: null' apps/api/src || true; echo ''; echo '=== TYPESCRIPT ==='; pnpm -C apps/api exec tsc --noEmit

tasks.label: Prisma · Erros de Migração
tasks.command: pnpm -C apps/api exec tsc --noEmit | grep -E 'modulos_assinatura|tokens|movimentos_estoque|locatario_id: null|WhereUniqueInput|CompoundUniqueInput|status_usuario' || true

tasks.label: API · Smoke Test Completo
tasks.command: TOKEN=$(curl -s -X POST http://localhost:3333/api/auth/login -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"slug":"loja","email":"adminloja@email.com.br","senha":"123456"}' | jq -r '.accessToken'); echo; echo "=== TOKEN ==="; echo "${TOKEN:0:50}..."; echo; echo "=== HEALTH ==="; curl -s http://localhost:3333/api/health | jq .; echo; echo "=== CLIENTES ==="; curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" http://localhost:3333/api/clientes | jq .; echo; echo "=== PRODUTOS ==="; curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" http://localhost:3333/api/produtos | jq .; echo; echo "=== TRANSACOES ==="; curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" http://localhost:3333/api/transacoes | jq .

tasks.label: API · Diagnóstico Login
tasks.command: echo '=== HEALTH RAW ==='; curl -i http://localhost:3333/api/health; echo; echo; echo '=== LOGIN RAW ==='; curl -i -X POST http://localhost:3333/api/auth/login -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"email":"adminloja@email.com.br","senha":"123456"}'
